cases.setup: Synthetic complete body and optional request body, full policy with established grant.
cases.trigger: Capture then seal and publish evidence.
expected: Exact bodies are members with matching measured sizes and SHA-256.
Body claims name only admitted blob members.

cases.setup: Same synthetic capture, hash_only.
cases.trigger: Capture through ordinary capture and file paths.
expected: Receipt contains metadata, exact size, digest, parser version and body_retained=false.
No source-body member, blob locator, replay claim, temporary source path or payload sentinel is present in uploadable trees.

cases.setup: Same capture, metadata_only.
expected: No public source SHA-256, blob locator or payload exists.
Measured size is labeled measured; Content-Length is not substituted.
capture_id, snapshot_id, URLs and errors do not encode or indirectly publish the raw body digest; dataset-generation digests remain a distinct identity.

cases.setup: One artifact receives concurrent publisher-bound full/hash_only/metadata_only captures.
expected: Each capture obeys its immutable source policy.
One evidence input binds the generation.
A public blob from another scope is never referenced by hash_only.

cases.setup: Refusal carries attached CapturedBodyResponse; another carries a legacy RefusedResponse.
expected: Both code paths obey the selected policy, including refused request bodies.
Non-full diagnostics use reason codes and omit raw exception payload snippets.

cases.setup: Stream redirects, request body, malformed gzip, then final parser rejection.
expected: Complete native response hashes survive parse/decoding refusal.
No body is admitted at redirect, retry or failure stages.
Journal records the observed encoding.

cases.setup: Stream fails, overruns byte cap, or reaches deadline before completion.
expected: Receipt records incomplete bytes_received without complete source digest or completeness claim.
No candidate accepted scope; prior data survives.

cases.setup: Capture includes 401/403 or a configured credential split across chunks.
cases.trigger: Capture or stream with each policy.
expected: Run aborts, no source body is stored.
Metadata is scrubbed before truncation; credential prefixes do not survive.

cases.setup: Journal write failure or corrupt blob write occurs inside a publisher task.
cases.trigger: Task mistakenly catches broad exception and continues.
expected: Poisoned run cannot seal build-complete or publish.
Failure outcome retained when storage permits.

cases.setup: New version-2 artifact claims hash_only but has a source-body blob, orphan file, forbidden URL, or digest/size mismatch.
expected: Semantic admission refuses before pointer movement.

cases.setup: Pinned legacy full artifact, older artifact-local blob layout and newer shared-blob layout.
cases.trigger: Read and audit with new implementation.
expected: Old artifacts retain original identity and remain readable.
Missing evidence_version means legacy full; an unknown explicit version refuses.
Existing federal callers retain full source bodies by default without new configuration.

cases.setup: Hash-only and metadata-only receipts; prior lineage root remains producer-owned metadata.
expected: Digest-only captures do not require blob members.
Body shape, authenticity and replay checks explicitly unavailable by policy.
Public metadata and table-cell credential checks still run.
Prior metadata cannot be confused with source-body retention.

cases.setup: Synthetic source sentinel is spooled, extracted and rendered; process exits abnormally or is killed.
expected: No source bytes or full extraction assets enter output/source-evidence or output/.
Private spool sits outside all upload roots even when cleanup cannot run.

cases.setup: Server returns 304 with no retained source body.
expected: Do not parse a bodyless response or claim a new complete snapshot.
Unconditional refetch or refusal preserves prior scope.

cases.setup: Prior editions A and B; new complete A bundle contains fewer member/item rows.
expected: All A-dependent rows are replaced consistently; vanished A children removed.
B rows and observation/snapshot identities unchanged.
Exact removed identities journaled.

cases.setup: Prior A has items; complete new A explicitly has no disclosed items but retains member ratings.
expected: A item-dependent tables become valid zero-row scopes.
A metadata and ratings remain; no invented zero ratings.

cases.setup: Prior editions A and B; A succeeds; B gets 404, 500, challenge HTML, zero bytes or changed layout.
expected: A advances; every B table preserves prior rows.
B refusal recorded and historical edition not retired.
Generation is marked complete as a replacement result with partial source coverage.

cases.setup: All requested editions fail, with and without a prior generation.
expected: No new generation or pointer change.
Run fails with per-scope outcomes; no empty corpus publication.

cases.setup: Registry has no due source; prior exists.
expected: Explicit no-op outcome; no copied fake refresh generation.
last_successful_scope_at remains unchanged.

cases.setup: Discovery no longer lists a historical edition.
expected: Historical rows remain and discovery omission is recorded only as an observation.

cases.setup: Edition defined as both chambers; only House succeeds.
expected: Whole edition is refused unless frozen schema and adapter explicitly define independent subscopes on all dependent tables.
Prior Senate and House data remain coherent.

cases.setup: Duplicate/non-null key violation, orphan relationship, scope identity drift, or declared count mismatch.
expected: Scope rejected before merge_table can deduplicate or filter rows.
No partial table from the rejected bundle admitted.

cases.setup: Managed prior member missing or digest mismatch; a stale local file is available.
expected: Abort rather than use local fallback or cold start.

cases.setup: Legitimate complete source correction exceeds existing byte shrink guard.
expected: Pointer unchanged; review required through existing explicit override.
Completeness witness never bypasses shrink protection automatically.

cases.setup: All candidate tables valid except one absent/invalid table or failed evidence admission.
expected: No family pointer advances.
Every declared table required, including real zero-row tables.

cases.setup: Scorecards writers X and Y read same prior; X publishes first.
expected: Y refuses stale family and preserves X; rebuild from fresh index needed.

cases.setup: Another unrelated family publishes while scorecards uploads.
expected: Retry preserves other family and merges unchanged scorecards base.
No silent family/table ownership change.

cases.setup: Upload interrupted, remote member corrupted, or evidence input pin differs.
expected: Prior pointer remains current; unreferenced immutable objects may remain.

cases.setup: Network fails after conditional pointer request was submitted.
expected: Outcome reported unknown until public readback.
Exact intended pin determines whether publish succeeded; no blind destructive retry.

cases.setup: Captured source/member/vote/bill pins; current upstream advances during resolution.
cases.trigger: Finish analysis using original immutable inputs.
expected: All declared parent digests match captured index.
No input changes mid-query; output names exact original pins and staleness relative to current data.
Source publication unaffected.

cases.setup: Local input modified or substituted after snapshot selection.
expected: Parent digest validation refuses mismatched managed input.

cases.setup: Dirty provider checkout contains unrelated extraction/schema/dependency edits.
cases.trigger: Build isolated scorecard candidate from pinned archive and explicit reviewed patch.
expected: Wheel tree differences contain only reviewed source/dependency changes.
Provider and receiver tests import candidate wheel from isolated environment.
Both build receipts and SHA-256 match; no shared environment or dirty-tree contamination.

cases.setup: New source and analysis tables installed through reviewed wheel.
cases.trigger: Run hosted-rollup, dictionary and MCP tests.
expected: Exactly one writer per table; complete source-family membership.
Registry selectors fail closed; disabled sources never acquired.
MCP source availability follows actual publication, not declarations alone.

cases.setup: Manual current refresh and historical backfill start concurrently.
cases.trigger: Dispatch through configured workflow concurrency group.
expected: Both use same scorecards family group; no active-run cancellation.
Invocation captures exact selectors, policy/config version and code revision without source secrets.

cases.setup: Build-only candidate is qualified and intended target selected.
cases.trigger: Perform separately authorized first publish and readback.
expected: Anonymous audit verifies family/table/evidence pins and qualified scope counts.
Existing MCP tools read new tables with publisher attribution.
Schedule stays disabled until successful readback; rollback target recorded.
